package serial

import (
	"testing"

	"golang.org/x/sys/windows"
)

func TestConfigurationTransactionsPreserveBothUpdates(t *testing.T) {
	dtr := func(p Port) error { return p.SetDTR(false) }
	rts := func(p Port) error { return p.SetRTS(false) }
	mode := func(p Port) error { return p.SetMode(&Mode{BaudRate: 57600}) }
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name   string
		first  func(Port) error
		second func(Port) error
		flags  uint32
		baud   uint32
	}{
		{"DTR-RTS", dtr, rts, 0, 115200},
		{"RTS-DTR", rts, dtr, 0, 115200},
		{"Mode-DTR", mode, dtr, windows.RTS_CONTROL_ENABLE, 57600},
		{"DTR-Mode", dtr, mode, windows.RTS_CONTROL_ENABLE, 57600},
		{"Mode-RTS", mode, rts, windows.DTR_CONTROL_ENABLE, 57600},
		{"RTS-Mode", rts, mode, windows.DTR_CONTROL_ENABLE, 57600},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			probeReset()
			p, err := Open("SIMULATED", &Mode{BaudRate: 115200})
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			defer p.Close()
			mask := uint32(windows.DTR_CONTROL_ENABLE | windows.RTS_CONTROL_ENABLE)
			probeState.Lock()
			initial := probeState.dcb
			probeState.armed = true
			probeState.Unlock()
			if initial.Flags&mask != mask || initial.BaudRate != 115200 {
				t.Fatalf("initial DCB flags=%x baud=%d", initial.Flags, initial.BaudRate)
			}
			firstDone := make(chan error, 1)
			go func() { firstDone <- tc.first(p) }()
			<-probeState.firstWrite
			secondDone := make(chan error, 1)
			go func() { secondDone <- tc.second(p) }()
			earlySnapshot := false
			select {
			case <-probeState.contention:
			case <-probeState.secondSnapshot:
				earlySnapshot = true
			}
			close(probeState.releaseFirst)
			if err := <-firstDone; err != nil {
				t.Errorf("first setter: %v", err)
			}
			if err := <-secondDone; err != nil {
				t.Errorf("second setter: %v", err)
			}
			probeState.Lock()
			final := probeState.dcb
			gets, sets := probeState.gets, probeState.sets
			probeState.Unlock()
			if earlySnapshot {
				t.Error("second transaction took its snapshot before the first committed")
			}
			if final.Flags&mask != tc.flags || final.BaudRate != tc.baud {
				t.Errorf("lost configuration update: flags=%x baud=%d; want flags=%x baud=%d", final.Flags&mask, final.BaudRate, tc.flags, tc.baud)
			}
			if gets != 2 || sets != 2 {
				t.Errorf("transactions: gets=%d sets=%d; want two each", gets, sets)
			}
		})
	}
}
